```
def calculate_unused_wire_length(N, M):
    if M < N:
        return -1
    
    permutations = [perm + 1 for perm in range(N)]
    unused_wire_length = 0
    total_wire_length = 0
    
    for permutation in permutations:
        for i in range(len(permutation)):
            if i > 0:
                unused_wire_length += abs(permutation[i] - permutation[i-1])
            if i < len(permutation) - 1:
                unused_wire_length += abs(permutation[i] - permutation[i+1])
        total_wire_length += sum(permutation)
    
    return unused_wire_length - (M - total_wire_length)
```
